verdict.score_rationale: The board is readable with effort at the 6–6.5 anchor: its regions and color-coded paths establish the system, but small text, long routed connections, and a congested routing junction prevent fluent arm’s-length reading.

sub_checks.name: corridors_and_air
sub_checks.note: Most nodes and label chips have clear surrounding space, but the small type and several chips placed directly amid route traffic—especially around the tier router—require close viewing.

sub_checks.name: grouping
sub_checks.note: The six numbered, lightly tinted regions make functional ownership readily apparent, with distinct admission, preparation, capacity, delivery, accounting, and shadow-evaluation areas.

sub_checks.name: edge_legibility
sub_checks.note: Arrowheads, labels, colors, and dashed styles usually communicate direction, but long cross-region runs and the clustered green, orange, gray, and dashed-orange routes near the cache and tier router are slow to trace.

sub_checks.name: density_and_decomposition
sub_checks.note: The board decomposes admission, routing, provider choice, outcomes, retry, billing, and shadow paths, yet the main end-to-end flow is distributed across a very large canvas and must be reconstructed across several distant regions.
